chunks: They will then be thrown into Hell with those who had gone astray
ai.seo_question: Who is cast into Hell along with the disbelievers according to Surah Ash-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara (26:97) highlights the suddenness of divine retribution, where the disbelievers are thrust into Hell alongside the 'ghawun' (those who stray from the path). It underscores the concept of collective accountability, linking the fate of the general populace with the specific followers of the prophets who rejected their message, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of truth and the inevitability of justice.
